title: MoALD KAMIS live-animal market-day price quotes, Kenya
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development (MoALD) — Kilimo AgriMarkets Market Information System (KAMIS), search export
citation: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development (MoALD), Kenya. Kilimo AgriMarkets Market Information System (KAMIS), livestock market prices. kamis.kilimo.go.ke.
license: UNSTATED — the portal footer asserts 'Copyright (c) KAMIS' (contact info@kilimo.go.ke) and publishes no licence or terms of use; a reservation, not a grant. Read for analysis and display; do not upload to S3/CDH or offer bulk download until MoALD confirms terms.
method: git-full: _sources/kamis_build.py pulls one Excel export per species-year (export=excel&per_page=500000; the HTML table pages by a path offset, not page=), gates the downloaded row count against the portal's per_page=1 pagination total, canonicalises county spellings to county_key.parquet (raw spelling kept in county_raw), melts Wholesale/Retail into price_type, and FLAGS rather than drops dirty rows in qc_flag: launch_day_bulk (2021-05-24 upload-date backfill), duplicate, bad_county ('test'), nonpositive, outlier_vs_marketday_median (x5 / x0.2 vs same market-day median), unexpected_unit. Clean wholesale quotes feed the monthly medians in market_prices.parquet. No number typed by a model.
coverage: Cattle (id 140), Sheep (167), Goat (168), Camel (186), KES per head, with breed (classification), grade (1-3), sex (Male/Female/Castrate) and supply volume; 185 markets, 45 counties, 2021-05-24 to the pull date (camels to 2025-11-24). 116,575 priced rows at the 2026-10-23 pull, 11.9% flagged. No coordinates. DELIVERY: served only as market_prices_kamis.parquet.enc (KEP1 container: AES-256-GCM over the parquet bytes; key from _sources/.kamis_parquet_key or a PBKDF2 password; browser side helpers/encryptedParquet.js). This is obfuscation as a courtesy to MoALD while reuse terms are sought, not access control: a static page must hold whatever decrypts. The plain parquet is local and git-ignored.
used_by: Not yet wired into the notebook (data + metadata delivered 2026-10-23; the Figure 4.4 integration is held as a forward patch in playbook/handovers/KE-enso-explorer/dispatches/2026-10-23_kamis-fig44-integration.patch). Feeds the KAMIS monthly medians in market_prices.parquet. Refresh: skill update-kamis-market-prices.
